articles.title: Trump Wants an 'AI Force' — and Says AI Fears Are a 'Hoax'
articles.summary: President Trump says the U.S. will start an 'AI Force' and name an AI tsar. He thinks AI could be 25% of America's economy. But some AI leaders want to slow down and make safer rules first.

articles.title: Congo Starts Ebola Shots for Health Workers in Outbreak's Center
articles.summary: Congo began vaccinating health workers against Ebola in Bunia, the center of the worst outbreak ever. The vaccine, Ervebo, is normally for a different Ebola type, but may help. So far, 7,541 cases and 3,639 deaths.

articles.title: A Big Job With No Woman Ever In Charge — One Leader Just Dropped Out
articles.summary: Michelle Bachelet wanted to be the first woman to lead the United Nations. But after a secret vote on Friday, she quit the race. Only one of 15 countries said "keep going."
